description: Burnout Music | Slow Surbahar Instrumental | 3 Hours of Indian Classical Music to release stress and rest a burnt-out mind.

When you've got nothing left, let the sound carry the weight for a while. Three deep, slow hours of resonant surbahar in Raga Bhupali — low, unhurried, and grounding — made to play in the background while you decompress after a draining day, breathe, and let your nervous system finally power down.
No ads breaking the calm. Just continuous Indian classical music for stress relief and deep rest.
Best for: burnout recovery · after-work decompression · stress relief · evening wind-down · deep rest.
Put it on, lower the lights, and let yourself stop for a while. 🌙
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — slow deep Indian classical surbahar (bass sitar) in Raga Bhupali, resonant low plucked notes with long meend glides over a sustained tanpura drone, no tabla, very slow ~55 BPM, heavy grounding restful evening character, seamless loop.
suno_prompt_note: Surbahar rule: NO tabla (tabla is a Sitar marker; Bansuri/Surbahar go without). Deep-rest/stress lane: 'slow / very slow' IS allowed (audience is winding down). Bhupali = serene evening pentatonic, no tension notes — deepest-calm evening raga. Low BPM (~55) for restorative rest. Surbahar = forgiving on raga (instrument alone signals genre) but named anyway.
